lines.speaker: Recruiter
lines.text: Congratulations! You've been selected for a remote data-entry job paying $500 per day. No experience needed.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I didn't apply for this. How did you get my number?

lines.speaker: Recruiter
lines.text: Your profile matched our requirements. To start, we just need a small onboarding fee of $150 for your equipment and training kit.

lines.speaker: Recruiter
lines.text: Once you pay, your first paycheck will arrive in 24 hours. This offer is only available today.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Why do I have to pay to get a job?

lines.speaker: Recruiter
lines.text: It's fully refundable with your first salary. Send it via gift card or crypto and I'll secure your spot before someone else takes it.
